no_tenant_explained: Your account exists, but no tenant has you as a member, so there is no data for you to see. Ask an instance admin or a tenant’s owner to add you.
tenant_switch_failed: Could not switch to that tenant. You may no longer be a member of it.
tenant_changed: The tenant changed since this page was opened. Nothing was done; reload the page and try again.
admin_tenants_intro: Each tenant's data and API keys are kept apart from every other tenant's. Only an instance admin creates tenants, and a tenant cannot be deleted yet.
admin_tenant_slug_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. acme-prod.
admin_tenant_name_invalid: Give the tenant a name of at most 100 characters.
admin_tenant_slug_invalid: A slug is lowercase letters and digits, joined by single hyphens, at most 63 characters.
admin_tenant_slug_taken: Another tenant already has this slug.
admin_tenant_owner_missing: Choose an existing user as the owner.
admin_member_add_hint: An existing account. New accounts are made on the Users page.
admin_member_invalid: Choose a user and a role.
admin_member_exists: That user is already a member of this tenant.
admin_member_no_user: That user or tenant no longer exists. Reload the page.
admin_member_not_found: That member is no longer in this tenant. Reload the page.
admin_member_last_owner: A tenant keeps at least one owner. Make another member an owner first.
admin_member_no_candidates: Every user is already a member of this tenant.
admin_member_remove_explained: They lose access to this tenant's data at their next request. Their account stays.
admin_users_intro: The accounts of this panel. Sign-up is closed, so an account is made here or with scripts/create-user.ts.
admin_user_instance_admin_hint: Creates tenants and accounts and manages the members of every tenant.
admin_user_created: {email} was created. Add the account to a tenant on that tenant's page; until then it sees only a page saying it belongs to no tenant.
admin_user_email_invalid: That is not an e-mail address.
admin_user_exists: An account with this e-mail already exists.
admin_user_password_length: The password must be {min} to {max} characters long.
api_keys_intro: An agent sends its key in the DD-API-KEY header with every request. The intake refuses data that comes without a valid one. Data sent with a key goes to the tenant the key was made in.
api_key_created_explained: Copy it now: it will not be shown again. Only its hash is stored.
api_key_not_active_yet: The panel could not notify the intake, so the key starts working within 30 seconds, at the intake's next refresh.
api_key_new_hint: Name it after the machines that will use it.
api_key_name_invalid: Give the key a name of at most 100 characters.
api_key_id_invalid: The form did not name a valid key. Reload the page and try again.
api_key_not_found: That key is no longer in this tenant. Reload the page.
api_keys_empty: This tenant has no keys yet
api_keys_empty_hint: Create one to connect an agent.
api_key_delete_explained: The intake stops accepting this key, usually at once and within 30 seconds at most. This cannot be undone.
api_key_not_revoked_yet: The key is deleted, but the panel could not notify the intake, so it may accept the key for up to 30 more seconds.
overview_intro: The instance is up and waiting for data.
overview_first_steps_hint: Three things to start seeing anything.
overview_step_agent_hint: Set DD_DD_URL to this instance's address and restart the agent.
overview_step_data_hint: The first metrics should show up within about 20 seconds.
overview_step_monitor_hint: A threshold on a metric you care about.
overview_connect_more: Logs, traces and the process agent have variables of their own, described in
monitors_intro: Datadog's metric monitors, evaluated here: each group's state, from the definitions below.
monitors_empty: This tenant has no monitors yet
monitors_empty_hint: Create one here, or from a query in the metrics explorer.
monitors_status_unavailable: The states could not be read, so they are not shown: {reason}
monitor_delete_explained: Its open groups are closed and it is no longer evaluated. What it went through stays in its history.
monitor_not_found: This tenant has no such monitor. It may have been deleted.
monitor_method_threshold_hint: Alert when a value crosses a threshold.
monitor_method_change_hint: Alert when a value changes by more than a threshold.
monitor_method_anomaly_hint: Alert when a value leaves the range its history expects.
monitor_method_outlier_hint: Alert when one group behaves unlike the others.
monitor_method_forecast_hint: Alert when a value is about to cross a threshold.
monitor_method_not_evaluated_yet: The monitor service does not evaluate this method yet. The monitor is checked and saved, and each evaluation records an error until it does.
monitor_editor_intro: Datadog's monitor, in its four steps. It is checked as you go, with the code that evaluates it.
monitor_simple_alert: Simple alert: one state for everything the query reads. Group by a tag to alert per group.
monitor_multi_alert: Multi alert: one state per group of {keys}.
monitor_chart_pick_metric: Pick a metric to see what the monitor would evaluate.
monitor_chart_empty: No points in this range. Try a longer one.
monitor_query_hint: The monitor evaluates the query. To combine queries, add a formula.
monitor_formula_hint: The monitor evaluates the formula, over the queries by name.
monitor_count_default_zero: Empty buckets of a count are 0
monitor_timezone_deviation: Stored, not acted on: unlike Datadog, seasons have a fixed length, so daily and weekly models are an hour off for about a week after each daylight saving change.
monitor_outlier_explained: A group alerts while it is an outlier. It needs a group-by and at least three groups.
monitor_anomaly_thresholds_explained: The share of points in the trigger window outside the bounds, from 0 to 1. 1 alerts when every point is anomalous.
monitor_missing_notify: Notify after a time without data
monitor_missing_default: Evaluate as 0 (sums and counts), else keep the state
monitor_require_full_window: Require a full window of data
monitor_message_hint: Datadog's template, stored as written. Notifications are not sent yet.
monitor_not_acted_on_hint: Notifications are not sent yet. These options are saved with the monitor so it keeps them when they are.
monitor_include_tags: Include the triggering tags in the title
monitor_notify_audit: Notify when the monitor is changed
monitor_check_ok: The monitor can be evaluated as it stands.
monitor_json: The Datadog JSON that will be stored
monitor_unfilled_metric: Pick a metric, or write a query.
monitor_unfilled_formula: With more than one query, add a formula that combines them.
monitor_unfilled_parameters: Fill in the detection method's parameters.
monitor_query_names_repeated: Two queries have the same name.
monitor_not_from_editor: This monitor was not written by the editor, so the editor cannot open it. Its query:
monitor_drifted: The stored definition is not what the editor last saved; saving replaces it with what is shown below. The stored query:
monitor_evaluations_truncated: Only the newest values were kept for this range; older ones are not drawn.
monitor_name_too_long: A monitor's name is at most {max} characters.
monitor_tag_invalid: A tag is from 1 to {max} characters.
monitor_form_invalid: The form did not carry a monitor. Reload the page and try again.
monitor_validate_failed: The monitor could not be checked: {reason}
monitor_metrics_unavailable: The metric list could not be read: {reason}
monitor_read_failed: Part of what the monitor went through could not be read: {reason}
monitor_times_local: Times in your time zone, {zone}. They are stored and evaluated in UTC.
monitor_evaluated_values_hint: What each evaluation measured, per group, against the current thresholds.
monitor_no_transitions: No group changed state in this range.
monitor_no_groups: No groups found: nothing the query reads has been evaluated, or every group was closed.
